6.174 rsScopeInPageSectionExpression
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
rsScopeInPageSectionExpression is a critical error that will occur when an expression within a
PageHeaderFooter element contains an aggregate function with a provided Scope parameter.
